speaker: SPEAKER_01
transcript: Hi there and welcome to the Manufacturing Report for the week of April 10. I'm Scott Paul, President of the Alliance for American Manufacturing and host of this podcast. You can find this and past episodes of the Manufacturing Report on iTunes and SoundCloud and on our Facebook page at American Manufacturing. If you'd like to hear more of this, please take a moment to like the podcast and perhaps even write a review and share with a friend who would enjoy hearing the Manufacturing Report. You can tweet us at KeepIt Made in USA and you can connect with us on our website, americanmanufacturing.org. This week we'll explore buying American with your tax dollars and how this issue could create an unlikely alliance between Senate Democrats and President Trump if the White House follows through on its plan. Let's get started. President Donald Trump has been proclaiming his bi-American, higher American plan frequently. But what does the president mean when he says this? America has had bi-America policies on the books for more than 80 years. It means that certain types of goods made possible by federal spending, like assembling warplanes or building bridges, must be made in America. We at the Alliance for American Manufacturing have been working on this issue for the past decade. And for the better part of that, so has Wisconsin Senator Tammy Baldwin. Senator Baldwin has been a great leader on by America policies and in particular on ensuring our nation's water infrastructure. Everything from manhole covers on sewers to the water pipes that bring drinking water to our homes are made in America. I had a chance to sit down with Senator Baldwin, who has written a new piece of legislation to strengthen by America laws to get her take on working with the president on by America policies, as well as where she sees America's trade agenda heading. Let's have a listen. And I'm honored to have as a guest Senator Tammy Baldwin from the great state of Wisconsin. Thank you for joining us on the Manufacturing Report, Senator Baldwin.
